I launched the Cascadefund as its third iteration on open source sustainability. 
Could you guys check and share it with open source devs you know? 

It's ecosystem building by users and open source maintainers together. Any feedback to improve it is welcome. As well as any advice on how to find a market fit as well. 

<https://cascadefund.org|https://cascadefund.org> - website for open source. I'll be more happy to get your attention than Instagram models reply. )
